control.description-key: Recursive inspection checklist with cross-question rules and a live, explained risk score. Canvas passes data in as JSON; the component never calls Dataverse.

property.name: QuestionsJson
property.description-key: JSON(colQ): QId, Code, QText, Help, ParentId, Stage, SortKey, AnswerType, Options, ShowOp, ShowVal, RiskOp, RiskVal, Weight, Critical, Rule.

property.name: RulesJson
property.description-key: Active fp_riskrule rows: Code, Name, Bonus, Explanation, Rule, Active.

property.name: AnswersJson
property.description-key: Answers to load: QId, Code, Value. A new value replaces the answers in the component.

property.name: AnswersOut
property.description-key: Answers to visible questions only: QId, Code, Value, Contribution.

property.name: CriticalHit
property.description-key: True when a critical-stop question triggered.

property.name: ExplanationJson
property.description-key: Every point in the score: Kind (question or rule), Code, Label, Points, Critical.
